topics.label: Geography
topics.definition: The natural setting, territorial extent, physical features and environmental conditions of places.
includes: Location, area, topography, geology, climate, natural species and land surveys.
excludes: Administrative organisation without geographical substance
extractive output alone.

topics.label: Disasters
topics.definition: Destructive natural or accidental events, their losses, preparedness and responses.
includes: Earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, floods, famine, storms, fires, disaster losses and relief.
excludes: Routine weather
disease incidence without a disaster frame
preventive public works without a disaster purpose.

topics.label: Population
topics.definition: The size, composition, distribution and movement of human populations and their vital events.
includes: Population and household counts, demographic characteristics and vital statistics.
Migration and the demographic circumstances of resident communities.
excludes: Use the subject topic for workers, patients or pupils counted only as participants in an institution or activity.
A place or ethnic label alone does not make an unrelated economic table demographic.

topics.label: Government
topics.definition: The institutions, personnel, territorial organization and legal foundations through which public authority is exercised.
includes: Central and local administration, political institutions, elections and public officials.
Constitutions, laws, administrative jurisdictions and official status.
excludes: Government ownership or provision alone: use the substantive topic for state factories, hospitals or schools.
Public revenue, expenditure and debt without administrative substance belong under finance.

topics.label: Informal imperialism
topics.definition: Foreign power exercised through unequal privileges, jurisdiction, strategic footholds or control without formal incorporation into the ruling power’s colonial administration.
includes: Foreign concessions, treaty-port privileges, extraterritorial jurisdiction and foreign garrisons.
Documented foreign direction of a nominally sovereign state or its institutions.
excludes: Formal colonial government, annexed possessions, protectorates, mandates and formally administered colonial leased territories: use colonial-rule.
Foreign trade, investment, migration or observations about Manchoukuo do not establish imperial control by themselves.

topics.label: Colonial rule
topics.definition: Formal political rule over annexed territories, colonies, protectorates, mandates or colonial territories administered under lease.
includes: Colonial governing institutions and the establishment or change of formal colonial status.
Settlement, assimilation or resistance when colonial rule itself is a substantive subject.
excludes: Unequal foreign privileges or external control in nominally sovereign territory without formal colonial administration: use informal-imperialism.
Statistics about a colony’s crops, population or schools without substantive evidence about colonial power: use their subject topics.

topics.label: Indigenous peoples
topics.definition: Indigenous communities, their societies, livelihoods and relationships with governing authorities.
includes: Identified indigenous peoples as the substantive subject, including historical accounts and community statistics.
Policies, frontier control and institutions specifically directed at indigenous communities.
excludes: Do not classify every ethnic minority or every historically named tribe as indigenous solely from a label.
A geographic location associated with indigenous peoples does not justify the topic for unrelated production or infrastructure.

topics.label: Foreign relations
topics.definition: Official relations between states and their participation in international institutions.
includes: Diplomacy, recognition, treaties, international negotiations and interstate disputes.
Diplomatic and consular missions and international organizations.
excludes: Cross-border trade, finance or migration without diplomatic or interstate substance.
A foreign nationality or country comparison alone.

topics.label: Military
topics.definition: Armed forces, warfare, defence organization and preparation for or conduct of military operations.
includes: Service branches, equipment, recruitment, defence institutions and military operations.
Military mobilisation, casualties and civil air-defence arrangements.
excludes: Civilian aviation, shipping or manufacturing without an explicit defence purpose.
Ordinary police work and criminal cases without military participation or purpose.

topics.label: Economy
topics.definition: The organisation, coordination and overall performance of economic activity.
includes: Economic plans, controls, cooperatives and supply policies
Aggregate economic output and recovery
excludes: A single industry's physical production without economic policy
Banking or government accounts alone

topics.label: Finance
topics.definition: Public and private money, credit, investment, insurance and financial accounts.
includes: Government revenue, expenditure, taxation and debt
Banks, currency, capital and insurance
excludes: Merchandise volumes alone
A company's physical output without financial measures

topics.label: Trade
topics.definition: Exchange and commercial distribution of goods and services within or across borders.
includes: Imports, exports, prices, companies and markets
Trade regulation and commercial organisations
excludes: Production without exchange or distribution
Transportation traffic without trade measures

topics.label: Agriculture
topics.definition: Cultivation, animal husbandry and the land, inputs and practices supporting farming.
includes: Crops, cultivated area, farm tenure, livestock, sericulture, irrigation and agricultural improvement.
excludes: Commercial forestry and capture fisheries alone
food manufacturing without a substantive farming subject.

topics.label: Forestry
topics.definition: Forest resources, their cultivation, protection, harvesting and primary forest products.
includes: Forest area, standing timber, logging, afforestation, camphor, bamboo, fuelwood and charcoal.
excludes: General wild species inventories
paper manufacture without forest resources or forestry activity.

topics.label: Fisheries
topics.definition: Capture and cultivation of aquatic resources and the organisation of their exploitation.
includes: Marine and inland fishing, aquaculture, whaling, seaweed and fishing rights.
excludes: Salt manufacture without aquatic-resource harvesting
food processing without a substantive fisheries subject.

topics.label: Mining
topics.definition: Mineral resources and their exploration, rights, extraction and primary preparation.
includes: Mineral deposits, mines, quarries, coal, petroleum, ores, salt and mining concessions.
excludes: Metal manufacture without mineral extraction or commodity content
utility supply alone.

topics.label: Manufacturing
topics.definition: Transforming raw materials into industrial, artisan or processed products.
includes: Factories, industrial output, textiles, metals, machinery, chemicals, processed foods and cottage industries.
excludes: Agricultural harvests and mineral extraction alone
construction or utility operations alone.

topics.label: Utilities
topics.definition: Public and industrial service infrastructure and civil works that supply or improve the built environment.
includes: Electricity, gas, water, sewerage, construction, river works, land reclamation and urban planning.
excludes: Transport or communications operations alone
disaster losses without infrastructure or service content.

topics.label: Transportation
topics.definition: Systems and services moving people or goods by land, water or air.
includes: Rail, road, tram, shipping and aviation networks and traffic
Ports, transport costs, tourism and transport safety
excludes: Post and telecommunications alone
Vehicle manufacture without transport operation

topics.label: Communications
topics.definition: Networks and services transmitting messages, mail and broadcasts.
includes: Postal, telegraph, telephone and radio operations
Postal financial services when the postal channel is explicit
excludes: Transport described historically as communications but carrying people or cargo
Newspaper and book publishing alone

topics.label: Labour
topics.definition: Employment, remuneration, work conditions and organisation of workers.
includes: Employment and placement, wages, hours and labour relations
Occupational accidents and identified worker groups
excludes: General population by occupation without employment measures
Household consumption alone

topics.label: Education
topics.definition: Teaching, learning and the institutions, people and resources supporting them.
includes: Schools, pupils, teachers and education expenditure
Higher, vocational, adult and special education and libraries
excludes: Scientific research without instruction
Religious adherents or worship without teaching

topics.label: Religion
topics.definition: Religious traditions, belief communities, worship and religious organisations.
includes: Named religions, rites, adherents and religious institutions
Missionary activity and religious propagation
excludes: An ethnic classification without religious evidence
Secular education or art merely located in a temple

topics.label: Crime and justice
topics.definition: Law enforcement, judicial proceedings, offences, punishment and the administration of justice.
includes: Police, courts, criminal and civil proceedings, detention and correctional institutions.
Illegal trade, regulated sex work and coercive enforcement when these are the substantive subject.
excludes: An activity is not a justice subject merely because it is regulated by law.
Constitutions and legislative organization without adjudication or enforcement belong under government.

topics.label: Narcotics
topics.definition: Opium and other narcotic drugs: their production, distribution, use, control and treatment of dependence.
includes: Poppy cultivation, narcotic trade, state monopolies, licensing and suppression.
Drug consumption, dependence and services treating narcotic addiction.
excludes: Alcohol and tobacco unless the table substantively addresses a narcotic alongside them.
General medicines, pharmacy or medical services without a narcotic subject.

topics.label: Health
topics.definition: Human or animal health, disease prevention, medical care and the conditions affecting health.
includes: Disease, mortality by health cause, medical personnel and institutions, preventive services and sanitation.
Nutrition, maternal and child health, mental health, veterinary health and pharmaceuticals.
excludes: Population totals or births and deaths without a health measure or cause do not require health.
Water infrastructure, food output or welfare services without substantive health content use their own topics.

topics.label: Welfare
topics.definition: Living conditions and organized support for people facing poverty, dependency, displacement or other social needs.
includes: Relief, charitable institutions, child and family support, housing and household living standards.
Support for refugees, veterans and military families and work-relief schemes.
excludes: Ordinary wages, employment or commercial finance without a living-standard or support measure.
Medical treatment and education alone belong under health or education.

topics.label: Press
topics.definition: Production, circulation and regulation of printed publications and news.
includes: Newspapers, journals, books, publishers and news agencies
Censorship of publishing, broadcasting or films
excludes: Paper manufacture without publishing
General telecommunications traffic without news production

topics.label: Culture
topics.definition: Artistic expression, cultural institutions, heritage and recreation.
includes: Art, music, performance, cinema, museums and archaeology
Amusements and cultural participation
excludes: Sporting competition, records and clubs
Production of ordinary industrial goods without cultural content

topics.label: Sport
topics.definition: Organised physical games, athletic competition and sporting activity.
includes: Results and records, championships, clubs and sporting facilities
Recreational sports when the activity is explicit
excludes: General amusements and theatrical entertainment
A mountain's height without evidence of sporting use

topics.label: Science and technology
topics.definition: Scientific investigation, technical knowledge, invention and standards of measurement.
includes: Research institutions and activity, patents and inventions
Measurement systems and technical standards
excludes: Routine output of manufactured goods without technical or research content
School enrolment without scientific investigation

topics.label: History
topics.definition: Past events and historical change presented as a general account or chronology spanning several substantive subjects.
includes: General historical chronologies and event tables; accounts of successive historical periods and political or social change across subjects.
excludes: A dated series whose substantive subject is a specific sector, such as crop output or railway construction; calendar and era conversions alone.

tags.label: land area
tags.definition: The extent of a territory or a classified part of its land surface.
includes: Territorial area, boundaries expressed as area, and land-use area totals.
excludes: Population density without substantive area data
cadastral survey methods alone.

tags.label: physical geography
tags.definition: Natural landforms, location, geology, soils, coasts and other physical characteristics of a region.
includes: Mountains, lakes, coastlines, geological formations and soil descriptions.
excludes: Weather observations
mineral output or reserves without geographical description.

tags.label: weather
tags.definition: Atmospheric conditions and their observed or seasonal patterns.
includes: Temperature, rainfall, humidity, sunshine, frost, wind and climate comparisons.
excludes: Damage or relief from a particular storm
river discharge without weather data.

tags.label: flora and fauna
tags.definition: Wild plants and animals and their distribution or natural characteristics.
includes: Species inventories, native vegetation, wildlife populations and natural habitats.
excludes: Cultivated crop yields
livestock husbandry
commercial fish catches alone.

tags.label: earthquakes and volcanoes
tags.definition: Seismic activity and volcanic features, eruptions and associated effects.
includes: Earthquake frequency and intensity, volcanoes, eruptions and earthquake losses.
excludes: Other disasters
geological description with no seismic or volcanic subject.

tags.label: rivers and waterways
tags.definition: The physical characteristics, courses and water regimes of rivers and other inland waterways.
includes: River systems, lengths, drainage basins, lakes connected to waterways and seasonal navigability.
excludes: Cargo traffic alone
flood prevention works without substantive river description.

tags.label: land surveys
tags.definition: Measurement and mapping of land for geographical, cadastral or administrative knowledge.
includes: Surveyed acreage, cadastral surveying, triangulation and land survey operations.
excludes: Registration of ownership or deeds alone
crop area estimates without survey activity.

tags.label: floods
tags.definition: Inundation events and their incidence, extent, causes or consequences.
includes: River floods, storm surges, flooded districts and inundated acreage.
excludes: Flood prevention infrastructure without an inundation event
routine rainfall alone.

tags.label: famine
tags.definition: Severe food scarcity affecting populations and its incidence or consequences.
includes: Famine districts, affected population, starvation and crop failure explicitly linked to famine.
excludes: Ordinary food prices, rationing or nutrition without severe scarcity.

tags.label: disaster losses
tags.definition: Deaths, injuries and material or economic damage attributed to disasters.
includes: Destroyed buildings, damaged crops, disaster casualties and estimated losses.
excludes: Routine mortality without disaster attribution
relief expenditure alone.

tags.label: disaster relief
tags.definition: Aid, rescue, recovery support and public assistance responding to a disaster.
includes: Relief funds, emergency food, shelter, rescue operations and disaster assistance recipients.
excludes: Routine poor relief
preventive engineering without disaster response.

tags.label: fires
tags.definition: Uncontrolled fires and their incidence, causes or damage.
includes: Urban and rural fires, burned property, fire causes and conflagration losses.
excludes: Fire brigades or equipment without fire-event statistics
industrial fuel consumption.

tags.label: storms and typhoons
tags.definition: Severe atmospheric storms and their tracks, frequency or impacts.
includes: Typhoons, cyclones, violent storms and their damage.
excludes: Routine wind and rainfall observations
floods without a storm connection.

tags.label: firefighting
tags.definition: Organisation, personnel, equipment and activity for preventing or extinguishing fires.
includes: Fire brigades, fire engines, hydrants, fire prevention and emergency responses.
excludes: Fire loss statistics without response or prevention activity
military incendiaries.

tags.label: population totals
tags.definition: Counts, estimates or density of the total resident population of a place.
includes: Censuses, population estimates, urban and rural totals, and comparative population density.
excludes: Counts of employees, patients, pupils or passengers without a population denominator or demographic purpose.

tags.label: age and sex
tags.definition: The distribution or demographic characteristics of people by age or sex.
includes: Age groups, sex ratios, age pyramids and demographic tables cross-classified by age or sex.
excludes: Age or sex appearing only as a minor label in an otherwise unrelated institutional table.

tags.label: households
tags.definition: The number, size, composition or demographic circumstances of households and families.
includes: Household counts, persons per household, family composition and household demographic comparisons.
excludes: Household expenditure without household-demographic content: use household-budgets.
The administration of household registers: use household-registration.

tags.label: births and deaths
tags.definition: The occurrence, number or rate of births, stillbirths and deaths.
includes: Vital statistics, natural increase, fertility, death rates and stillbirths.
excludes: Age composition alone; use infant-mortality or a named health tag when the table’s focus is more specific.

tags.label: marriage and divorce
tags.definition: The formation and dissolution of marriages and people’s marital status.
includes: Marriage and divorce counts or rates, marriage age and marital-status distributions.
excludes: Family size alone; judicial divorce procedure without marriage or divorce outcomes.

tags.label: migration
tags.definition: Movement of people that changes their usual residence or records a recurring labour or settlement flow.
includes: Immigration, emigration, internal migration and seasonal migrant-worker arrivals and departures.
excludes: Passenger traffic, port landings and departures that do not establish migration.
Use settler-migration when settlement associated with colonial expansion or foreign state sponsorship is the evidenced specific subject.

tags.label: nationality and ethnicity
tags.definition: The composition or characteristics of people by nationality, ethnicity or the source’s racial classifications.
includes: Residents or migrant populations classified by nationality, citizenship, ethnic community or historically used racial categories.
excludes: The nationality of ships, trading partners or companies without a human-population subject.
Do not infer ethnicity from language, location or a publisher’s political claims.

tags.label: occupations
tags.definition: The distribution or classification of people by occupation, calling or livelihood.
includes: Population by profession, trade, occupational class or principal livelihood.
excludes: Wage levels, working hours or enterprise output without occupational-composition content.

tags.label: languages
tags.definition: Languages spoken or used by populations, communities or public services.
includes: Linguistic distribution, mother tongues, language use and services classified by language.
excludes: Language teaching or school curricula alone: use language-education.
The language in which a table is printed.

tags.label: overseas communities
tags.definition: Communities living outside their place of national or ethnic origin and their collective institutions or circumstances.
includes: Overseas residents, diaspora communities and their associations, schools or local distribution when the community is the subject.
excludes: Migration flows alone; foreign trade by country; automatically treating every overseas resident as a colonial settler.

tags.label: household registration
tags.definition: Systems and records that officially register households, family membership or changes in civil status.
includes: Household registers, registration offices, registered persons and entries or changes in civil registers.
excludes: Household totals from a census without a registration-system subject.

tags.label: suicide
tags.definition: Intentional self-inflicted deaths and recorded attempts to take one’s own life.
includes: Suicide totals and rates and their distribution by method, age, sex or recorded cause.
excludes: All-cause mortality; mental illness without suicidal behaviour; accidental deaths; self-injury without suicidal intent.

tags.label: infant mortality
tags.definition: Deaths or survival rates of infants, ordinarily before their first birthday.
includes: Infant and neonatal death counts, mortality rates and comparisons of infant survival.
excludes: Stillbirths counted separately by the source; deaths of older children without an infant measure.

tags.label: government offices
tags.definition: Public administrative bodies, their functions, officeholders and civil-service personnel.
includes: Ministries, boards, administrative organization, official appointments, staffing and civil-service salaries or allowances.
excludes: The activity of a public hospital, school or enterprise when administrative organization is incidental.
Use local-government for specifically local governing institutions.

tags.label: elections and parties
tags.definition: Electoral systems, voting, political parties and representative political organization.
includes: Franchise, electors, election results, party membership and elected assemblies or party organizations.
excludes: Appointments to a ministry without an electoral or party subject.

tags.label: local government
tags.definition: The institutions, personnel and administration of subnational governing authorities.
includes: Municipal, provincial, prefectural, county, district, village or banner government and local councils.
excludes: Local population or production alone; lists of territorial units without governing functions use administrative-divisions.

tags.label: imperial household
tags.definition: The reigning emperor or monarch, royal family, court and institutions or property attached to the royal household.
includes: Royal genealogies, succession, court officials, household organization and crown estates as royal property.
excludes: The whole empire merely because it has an emperor; ordinary government institutions unrelated to the court.

tags.label: honours and ranks
tags.definition: Official decorations, honours, precedence and civil or military status ranks.
includes: Orders, medals, recipients of honours, rank systems and officials classified by rank.
excludes: Salary tables without a substantive rank structure; a numbered list or league ranking.

tags.label: constitutions and laws
tags.definition: Constitutional arrangements, legislation and legal rules treated as texts, frameworks or legislative outputs.
includes: Constitutions, promulgated laws, legal reforms, law lists and the content or scope of statutes and regulations.
excludes: A statistical activity merely operating under a law; court case outcomes without a substantive legal-framework subject.

tags.label: administrative divisions
tags.definition: Territorial units, boundaries and jurisdictions used to organize government.
includes: Provinces, prefectures, counties, municipalities, banners and changes to their administrative boundaries or status.
excludes: Physical landforms and area alone; activity totals merely grouped by province.

tags.label: passports and travel permits
tags.definition: Official documents and permissions authorizing travel, entry, exit or residence.
includes: Passports, visas, travel passes, permits and their issue, refusal or administration.
excludes: Migration totals without a documentary-permission subject; ordinary travel timetables or fares.

tags.label: foreign concessions
tags.definition: Territorial concessions or foreign-administered settlements granted through unequal arrangements in a nominally sovereign state.
includes: Foreign settlements, concession governments, special foreign rights and their geographic or institutional extent.
excludes: Ordinary commercial contracts or mining licences; formal colonial administration of annexed or colonial leased territories.

tags.label: extraterritoriality
tags.definition: Exemption from local jurisdiction through foreign or consular legal authority.
includes: Consular courts, foreign jurisdiction, nationality-based legal privilege and its abolition or transfer.
excludes: Ordinary overseas diplomacy; court systems without foreign-jurisdiction privileges.

tags.label: treaty ports
tags.definition: Ports opened to foreign residence or commerce under a treaty-created system of special rights.
includes: Treaty-port status, opening agreements, institutions and port comparisons explicitly organized around that system.
excludes: Cargo or vessel totals for an ordinary port; a port’s treaty history does not make all its later trade tables treaty-port tables.

tags.label: foreign garrisons
tags.definition: Foreign armed forces stationed in another nominally sovereign territory under special rights or unequal power arrangements.
includes: Foreign troop stations, garrison privileges, deployment and support of such foreign forces.
excludes: A state’s ordinary home garrisons; colonial forces where formal colonial administration is the subject.

tags.label: annexation and protectorates
tags.definition: The establishment, terms or termination of annexation or formal protectorate status.
includes: Annexation agreements, protectorate treaties, transfers of sovereignty and changes in formal dependency.
excludes: A declaration of statehood or diplomatic recognition without annexation or protectorate status.
Foreign economic influence without a formal status change.

tags.label: colonial administration
tags.definition: The governing machinery, powers and practices of formally administered colonial territories.
includes: Governors-general, colonial departments, mandated administration, colonial legal regimes and administration of colonial leased territories.
excludes: An ordinary administrative table in a nominally sovereign state without formal colonial jurisdiction.
Production or social observations in a colony when the governing relationship is incidental.

tags.label: settler migration
tags.definition: Organized settlement migration associated with colonial expansion or foreign state-sponsored settlement projects.
includes: Settler groups, settlement locations, pioneer schemes, settler subsidies and their land or demographic circumstances.
excludes: Ordinary migrant labour or overseas residents without an evidenced settlement scheme.
A settler table does not by itself establish that its territory was formally colonized.

tags.label: assimilation policies
tags.definition: Policies intended to remake a subject community’s language, identity, customs or social institutions to conform to a ruling group.
includes: Explicit assimilation programmes, compulsory identity or language changes and related institutions.
excludes: Japanese-language schools, religious institutions or cultural change without evidence of an assimilation policy.

tags.label: independence movements
tags.definition: Collective political action seeking self-rule or freedom from colonial or dependent status.
includes: Independence organizations, anti-colonial campaigns, self-government movements and documented resistance pursuing sovereignty.
excludes: Official founding declarations or recognition of a new regime without a popular or organized independence movement.
Criminal or armed groups whose political purpose is not established.

tags.label: frontier policing
tags.definition: Policing and coercive control of frontier areas or indigenous communities.
includes: Frontier police, expeditions described as pacification, security posts and enforcement directed at indigenous areas.
excludes: Ordinary urban policing; every military campaign or border dispute; an indigenous location without policing content.

tags.label: guard lines
tags.definition: Guarded barriers or lines of posts used to control access, movement or territory along an indigenous or colonial frontier.
includes: Guard lines, barrier posts, frontier cordons and their staffing, length, costs or extension.
excludes: Railway guards, ordinary border stations or historic walls unless their frontier-control function is the subject.

tags.label: diplomatic service
tags.definition: Diplomatic and consular missions, representatives and the official services that conduct foreign relations.
includes: Embassies, legations, consulates, ambassadors, consular officers and establishments abroad.
excludes: Foreign residents or traders without an official diplomatic role; interstate agreements without service or mission content.

tags.label: treaties
tags.definition: Formal agreements between states and the negotiation, operation or termination of those agreements.
includes: Treaties, protocols, interstate conventions, trade or navigation agreements and treaty-text indexes.
excludes: Private commercial agreements; a trade table that merely concerns countries with a treaty.

tags.label: international organisations
tags.definition: Intergovernmental or international coordinating institutions, their membership, proceedings and activities.
includes: The League of Nations, international commissions and conferences functioning as institutions, and participation or withdrawal.
excludes: Any foreign company or domestic association; a single bilateral treaty without an international institution.

tags.label: army
tags.definition: Land armed forces, their organization, personnel, units and military activities.
includes: Army formations, land-force stations, standing armies and army-specific equipment or expenditure.
excludes: Ordinary civilian police; naval or air forces unless army aviation is explicitly part of the land service.

tags.label: navy
tags.definition: Naval forces and their personnel, warships, bases and operations.
includes: Fleet organization, naval stations, gunboats, naval aviation and navy-specific expenditure.
excludes: Merchant shipping, civilian ports or commercial shipbuilding without naval content.

tags.label: war and mobilisation
tags.definition: Warfare, military campaigns and the mobilisation of people or resources for conflict.
includes: War operations, military incidents, requisition, wartime mobilisation laws and conflict-specific expenditure or losses.
excludes: Peacetime organization alone; ordinary economic plans without an explicit war or defence purpose.

tags.label: air force
tags.definition: Military aviation forces, their organization, aircraft, personnel and operations.
includes: Air units, military air bases, armed-service aviation and military aircraft strength.
excludes: Civil airlines, civil aircraft manufacture or civil airfields without military use as a substantive subject.

tags.label: arms and arsenals
tags.definition: Weapons, ammunition, military equipment and the facilities that produce or store them.
includes: Munitions, arsenals, arms manufacture, military stocks and captured weapons.
excludes: Industrial machinery, chemicals or explosives whose military use is not evidenced.

tags.label: military casualties
tags.definition: Deaths, wounds, missing personnel or other human casualties attributed to military service or operations.
includes: Battle casualties, forces’ losses and civilians explicitly enumerated as casualties of military conflict.
excludes: All-cause population deaths; property damage; ordinary crime victims without a military-operation connection.

tags.label: recruitment and conscription
tags.definition: The enlistment, compulsory recruitment or selection of personnel for military service.
includes: Conscription systems, recruits, examinations, exemptions, reserve call-ups and enlistment.
excludes: Total serving personnel without recruitment content; civilian employment placement.

tags.label: air defence
tags.definition: Measures to detect, deter or protect people and infrastructure against aerial attack.
includes: Air-raid precautions, warning systems, shelters, anti-aircraft defence and civil defence specifically against air attack.
excludes: Routine aviation safety, general firefighting or weather warnings.

tags.label: economic planning
tags.definition: Formal plans setting future economic development, investment or production objectives.
includes: Multi-year industrial plans
Planned capital outlay and production targets
excludes: Actual output without a plan
A company's ordinary annual budget

tags.label: economic controls
tags.definition: Administrative direction or restriction of economic activity and resource allocation.
includes: Industry control laws
Production allocation, licensing and compulsory coordination
excludes: Ordinary business association membership
Price movements without regulatory action

tags.label: price controls
tags.definition: Rules fixing or limiting prices, rents or permitted margins.
includes: Official maximum or minimum prices
Enforcement of price ceilings
excludes: Observed market prices without controls
General inflation measures

tags.label: inflation
tags.definition: A sustained rise in the general price level or loss of purchasing power.
includes: Inflation rates and general price-level increases
Currency depreciation explicitly analysed as inflation
excludes: A single commodity price
Exchange rates without evidence of domestic inflation

tags.label: cooperatives
tags.definition: Member-owned or mutual organisations conducting shared economic business.
includes: Consumer, producer, agricultural and credit cooperatives
Cooperative membership, capital and business
excludes: Ordinary joint-stock corporations
Trade unions organised for labour representation

tags.label: reconstruction
tags.definition: Restoration of economic assets, activity or infrastructure after damage or disruption.
includes: Postwar reconstruction
Rebuilding damaged railways, factories or settlements
excludes: Ordinary expansion without restoration
Disaster losses without recovery activity

tags.label: food supply and rationing
tags.definition: Provision, distribution and controlled allocation of food for consumption.
includes: Food balances, provisioning, stocks and ration allowances
Government food procurement and distribution
excludes: Crop output without supply or distribution measures
Nutritional disease alone

tags.label: state monopolies
tags.definition: Exclusive state rights or monopolistic state enterprises controlling specified products or services.
includes: Salt, tobacco, opium and alcohol monopolies
Monopoly sales, receipts and administration
excludes: Every publicly owned company
Private market concentration without state exclusivity

tags.label: rural development
tags.definition: Coordinated measures to improve rural economic conditions and infrastructure.
includes: Rural improvement programmes
Village development and agricultural settlement support
excludes: Crop output alone
Urban redevelopment

tags.label: production subsidies
tags.definition: Public grants or financial assistance supporting production or the operation of economic services.
includes: Industry and farm production grants
Subsidised shipping or air services and producer incentives
excludes: Ordinary government purchases
Poor relief or household welfare grants

tags.label: public budgets
tags.definition: Government revenue, expenditure and budget accounts at national or local level.
includes: General and special accounts
Municipal budgets and public expenditure by service
excludes: Private company revenue and expenditure
Debt balances without budget flows

tags.label: taxation
tags.definition: Taxes, their assessment, rates, receipts and distribution.
includes: Income, inheritance, business and other taxes
Tax burden per person or household
excludes: Prices or commercial fees
Government revenue entirely from non-tax sources

tags.label: public debt
tags.definition: Borrowing liabilities and debt service of national or local governments.
includes: Government loans, treasury debt and municipal bonds
Debt outstanding, issuance and repayment
excludes: Corporate borrowing without public guarantee or liability
Government spending without debt measures

tags.label: banking
tags.definition: Banks and their organisation, accounts, clearing and financial business.
includes: Central, ordinary, special and foreign banks
Bank assets, liabilities, deposits, loans and clearing houses
excludes: All non-bank credit by default
Currency manufacture without banking activity

tags.label: savings and loans
tags.definition: Deposits, savings and lending balances or transactions.
includes: Savings deposits, bank loans and postal savings
Loan amounts by borrower or purpose
excludes: Interest rates without loan or deposit amounts
Securities issuance without lending or saving

tags.label: currency
tags.definition: Monetary systems, coins, notes and reserves supporting money circulation.
includes: Currency issuance, circulation, metallic content and gold reserves
Monetary standards and convertibility
excludes: Mined gold output without monetary use
Exchange rates between currencies

tags.label: foreign exchange
tags.definition: Conversion, valuation and control of one currency against another.
includes: Exchange rates and quotations
Foreign-exchange transactions and controls
excludes: Domestic interest rates
Merchandise exports without currency conversion measures

tags.label: securities and investment
tags.definition: Investment capital, tradable financial claims and their returns or holdings.
includes: Shares, bonds, debentures, trusts and capital issues
